skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts related to communication theory.
Grasp the concepts of message creation and its impact on communication.
Develop creative messages for advertising and marketing communications.
Understand fundamental principles of advertising and their application in marketing communications.
Analyze consumer behavior in relation to media and communication channels.
Generate creative ideas for developing effective communication messages.
Write compelling messages for various communication platforms.
Design and select appropriate elements to illustrate communication messages effectively.
Implement effective communication strategies for products/services of businesses.
Make informed decisions about creative communication activities for business products/services.
Resolve issues related to creative communication activities.
Work collaboratively in groups to develop and present creative communication projects.
